<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Grand Elder Guru''' lives in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Grand Elder's House]] in the Sacred Land of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. He teaches no skills: his one service raises your [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] beyond the level the masters can teach.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The Grand Elder lives in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House|Grand Elder's House]], which generates once per world in the Sacred Land of Namek. The Capsule Corp Namekian sells a map to it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder's House#Finding it|Grand Elder's House]]). You reach Namek by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Unlock Potential == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
{{Main|Potential Unlock}}
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
* Masters sell [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] levels 1 to 10. The Grand Elder raises it from '''level 10 to 11''' if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] is 50 or higher. After that, levels 12 and 13 can be bought.
* Below alignment 50 he greets you coldly and the option stays locked.
* The option is also locked until you reach level 10, and once you're past it.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] quest 18, ''Journey to the Grand Elder'': find the Grand Elder's House and talk to Grand Elder Guru.
</translate>
